description: This file contains functions to manipulate browser state via Playwright, including setting offline mode, HTTP headers, credentials, geolocation, media emulation, locale, timezone, and device profiles.

methods.name: setOfflineViaPlaywright
methods.description: Sets the offline mode for a browser page.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeadersViaPlaywright
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for a browser page.

methods.name: setHttpCredentialsViaPlaywright
methods.description: Sets or clears HTTP credentials for a browser page.

methods.name: setGeolocationViaPlaywright
methods.description: Sets geolocation and permissions for a browser page.

methods.name: emulateMediaViaPlaywright
methods.description: Emulates media features like color scheme.

methods.name: setLocaleViaPlaywright
methods.description: Overrides the locale for a browser page.

methods.name: setTimezoneViaPlaywright
methods.description: Overrides the timezone for a browser page.

methods.name: setDeviceViaPlaywright
methods.description: Simulates a device profile for a browser page.
